```python
import numpy as np
import DREAM.Settings.Equilibrium as Equilibrium
import DREAM.Settings.RadialGrid as RadialGrid
import DREAM.Settings.TransportSettings as TransportSettings
import DREAM.Settings.Ions as Ions
import DREAM.Settings.CollisionHandler as CollisionHandler
import DREAM.Settings.ColdElectrons as ColdElectrons
import DREAM.Settings.HotElectrons as HotElectrons
import DREAM.Settings.ElectricField as ElectricField
import DREAM.Settings.TimeStepper as TimeStepper
import DREAM.Settings.Solver as Solver
import DREAM.Settings as ds
import DREAM

# Simulation parameters
nr = 10
r0 = 0.0
r1 = 0.2
nt = 50
tmax = 1e-3
t0 = 0.0
Te0 = 10   # Initial cold electron temperature [eV]
Te1 = 100  # Final cold electron temperature [eV]
E0 = 0.1   # Electric field [V/m]
ion_species = [{'name': 'D', 'Z': 1, 'n': 2e19}]
D_scalar = 1.0  # Constant scalar diffusion coefficient [m^2/s]

# Transport mode options: 'prescribed', 'svensson', 'none'
transport_mode = 'prescribed'
enable_hottail = True

# Set up DREAM settings
ds = ds.DREAMSettings()

# Radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(r1)
ds.radialgrid.setNr(nr)

# Time stepper
ds.timestep.setTmax(tmax)
ds.timestep.setNt(nt)

# Ions
for ion in ion_species:
    ds.ions.addIon(ion['name'], Z=ion['Z'], n=ion['n'])

# Electric field
ds.eqsys.E_field.setPrescribedData(E0)

# Cold electron temperature (linear ramp)
times = np.linspace(t0, tmax, nt)
Te_profile = np.linspace(Te0, Te1, nt)
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setPrescribedData(Te_profile, times=times)

# Enable hot-tail grid if requested
if enable_hottail:
    ds.hottailgrid.setEnabled(True)
    ds.hottailgrid.setNxi(8)
    ds.hottailgrid.setNp(40)
    ds.hottailgrid.setPmax(2)
else:
    ds.hottailgrid.setEnabled(False)

# Set up transport settings
if transport_mode == 'prescribed':
    # Prescribed constant scalar diffusion coefficient for n_re
    D_profile = D_scalar * np.ones((nt, nr))
    ds.transport.prescribeDiffusion('n_re', D_profile, times=times)
elif transport_mode == 'svensson':
    ds.transport.setSvenssonDiffusion('n_re', D_scalar)
elif transport_mode == 'none':
    ds.transport.prescribeDiffusion('n_re', np.zeros((nt, nr)), times=times)
else:
    raise ValueError("Unknown transport mode: {}".format(transport_mode))

# Set solver
ds.solver.setType(Solver.LINEAR)

# Run simulation
do = DREAM.runiface(ds, 'output_radial_transport.h5')
```
